name: Tile ControlNet for Stable Diffusion 1.5
summary: Holds a picture’s structure while it is repainted, for edits that keep the composition.
details: A ControlNet “tile” model. With it, Atlas’s Edit repaints a picture from your description while the composition stays; it also drives the detail pass of creative upscaling and the selective (inpainting) edits. Needs Stable Diffusion 1.5.

source.name: ControlNet v1.1 fp16 (comfyanonymous on Hugging Face)
